```{r}


first_stage_test_bis_nuclear <- first_stage_data %>%
  mutate(Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
    predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity >0),
    pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau = (Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity >0),
    unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau = (Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity >0)
    ) %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(creneau_unavailability = sum(predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_creneau_unavailability = sum(pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_creneau_unavailability = sum(unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>%
  mutate(day_unavailability = sum(predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_day_unavailability = sum(pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_day_unavailability = sum(unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(datetime)

```


```{r}

#il faut regarder si l'on est un seuil
# à savoir si le même creneau  de l'auction suivante 
# a une indisponibilité différente


price_data_nuclear <- first_stage_test_bis_nuclear %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, predicted_unavailability_creneau, predicted_unavailability_creneau - 
                    lag(predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         
         pub_unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau - 
                    lag(pub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau))),
         unpub_unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau, unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau - 
                    lag(unpub_nuclear_unavailability_creneau)))
         
         ) %>%
  ungroup()



price_data_nuclear %>% 
  filter(unavailability_trigger != 0, Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity != 0) %>%
  group_by(pub_unavailability_trigger, unpub_unavailability_trigger) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), 
            mean_price_diff = mean(price_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 
            mean_unavailability_size = mean(Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE))


```


```{r}

price_data_nuclear_suite <- price_data_nuclear %>%
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  # Définir l'enchère de référence
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, predicted_unavailability_creneau) %>%
  
  mutate(auction_before = as.numeric(auction_before), 
    reference_auction = ifelse(creneau_unavailability== 0, 
                                     sample(0:6, 1), min(auction_before[unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
    unavail_pub_level = ifelse(pub_creneau_unavailability== 0 | unpub_day_unavailability == 1 ,
         0, mean(Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity[pub_unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),

  unavail_pub_post_level = ifelse(pub_creneau_unavailability== 0,
         0, mean(Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity[pub_unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
  unavail_pub_post_level = unavail_pub_post_level - unavail_pub_level,
  
  unavail_pub_post_level = unavail_pub_post_level - unavail_pub_level,

     unavail_unpub_level = ifelse(unpub_creneau_unavailability== 0,
       0, mean(Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity[unpub_unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),

     unavail_level = ifelse(creneau_unavailability== 0,
     0, mean(Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity[unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),

    unavail_pub = unavail_pub_level* pub_unavailability_trigger,
    unavail_unpub = unavail_unpub_level* pub_unavailability_trigger,
    unavail_pub_post = unavail_pub_post_level* unpub_unavailability_trigger,
    unavail = unavail_level* unavailability_trigger,
    )%>% 
  
  # Filtrer pour ne garder que les distances entre -4 et 4
 
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  #fix reference auction, extend it to everyone
  mutate(reference_auction = max(reference_auction),
         distance_auction = as.numeric(auction_before) - as.numeric(reference_auction)) %>%
   filter(distance_auction >= -4 & distance_auction <= 4) %>% 
  ungroup()


 price_data_nuclear_wide <- price_data_nuclear_suite %>%
  # Agréger les valeurs si plusieurs existent par (date, creneau, distance)
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, distance_auction, 
           unavail, unavail_pub, unavail_unpub, unavail_pub_post) %>%
  summarise(price_diff = mean(price_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 
            reference_auction = first(reference_auction),
            .groups = "drop") %>%  
  # Transformer en format large par distance_auction
  pivot_wider(names_from = distance_auction, 
              names_prefix = "price_", 
              values_from = price_diff)

```



```{r}
#il y a souvent annonce, puis désannonce (à savoir fin de l'indisponibilité à un créneau suivant)
#attention je perds de la variation

            
price_data_nuclear_grouped <-  price_data_nuclear_wide %>%  
  arrange(electricity_delivery_date, creneau, unavail) %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  summarize(across(starts_with("price"), ~ ifelse(all(is.na(.)), NA, sum(., na.rm = TRUE))),
            creneau = first(creneau),
            reference_auction = first(reference_auction),
            unavail = last(unavail),
            unavail_pub = last(unavail_pub),
            unavail_pub_post = last(unavail_pub_post),
            unavail_unpub = last(unavail_unpub),
            electricity_delivery_date = first(electricity_delivery_date),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(unavail))

price_data_nuclear_grouped <- left_join(price_data_nuclear_grouped,
                                              first_stage_data %>% 
                                                select(electricity_delivery_date,creneau, gen_tot,
                                                       unpredicted_renewables, intraday_update_renewables, day_ahead_forecast, month, year, weekday) %>%  distinct(),
                                                by = c("electricity_delivery_date", "creneau"))


```


```{r}


table_coefficients_nuclear  <- data.frame()

for (col in colnames(price_data_nuclear_grouped)[3:11]){
  # Créer la formule pour la régression
  
  # Créer la formule en utilisant backticks pour le nom de colonne
  formula <- as.formula(paste("`" , col, "`" , " ~ unavail + gen_tot +
                              intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables + as.factor(reference_auction)+ as.factor(creneau)
                              " , sep = ""))
  
  # Ajuster le modèle
  model <- lm(formula, data = price_data_nuclear_grouped)
  
  vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(model, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ electricity_delivery_date)
  # Erreurs standard clusterisées
  cl_se<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
  
  
  coefficients <- summary(model)$coefficients
  n_ddl <- summary(model)$df[2]
  # Créer un dataframe temporaire avec les variables et les coefficients
  temp_df <- data.frame(variable = col,
                        estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
                        std_error = cl_se[2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                        t_value = coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                        p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de la valeur p
    # temp_df <- data.frame(variable = col,
    #                     estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
    #                     std_error = coefficients[2, 2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
    #                     t_value = coefficients[2, 3], # Recalcul de la valeur t
    #                     p_value = coefficients[2, 4])  # Recalcul de la valeur p
    # 
    # 
  # Ajouter les résultats à table_coefficients
  table_coefficients_nuclear  <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear , temp_df)
}

```



```{r}
table_coefficients_nuclear <- table_coefficients_nuclear %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)))


ggplot(data = table_coefficients_nuclear, aes( x = as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)) ,y = estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - qnorm(0.975)*std_error,
                  ymax = estimate + qnorm(0.975)*std_error), width = 0.2, alpha= 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  #coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Dynamic response to plant availability shock",
       x = "Auction",
       y = "EUR/MWh")

```

```{r}


table_coefficients_nuclear_bis  <- data.frame()


for (col in colnames(price_data_nuclear_grouped)[3:11]){
  # Créer la formule pour la régression
  formula <- as.formula(paste("`" , col, "`" , " ~ unavail_pub  + unavail_unpub+ unavail_pub_post + 
                              intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables + as.factor(reference_auction) + gen_tot
                              " , sep = ""))
  # Ajuster le modèle
  model <- lm(formula, data = price_data_nuclear_grouped)
  
  vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(model, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ electricity_delivery_date)
  # Erreurs standard clusterisées
  cl_se<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
  
  
  coefficients <- summary(model)$coefficients
  n_ddl <- summary(model)$df[2]
  # Créer un dataframe temporaire avec les variables et les coefficients
  temp_pub <- data.frame(status = "Published",
                         variable = col,
                        estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
                        std_error = cl_se[2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                        t_value = coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                        p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de
  
  temp_unpub <- data.frame(status = "Unpublished",
                           variable = col,
                        estimate = coefficients[3, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
                        std_error = cl_se[3],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                        t_value = coefficients[3, 1] / cl_se[3],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                        p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[3, 1] / cl_se[3]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de
  
  temp_pub_post <- data.frame(status = "Post-Published",
                           variable = col,
                        estimate = coefficients[4, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
                        std_error = cl_se[4],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                        t_value = coefficients[4, 1] / cl_se[4],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                        p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[4, 1] / cl_se[4]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de
  
  
  # Ajouter les résultats à table_coefficients
  table_coefficients_nuclear_bis  <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear_bis , temp_pub)
  table_coefficients_nuclear_bis  <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear_bis ,  temp_unpub)
  table_coefficients_nuclear_bis  <- rbind(table_coefficients_nuclear_bis ,  temp_pub_post)
}

```



```{r}

table_coefficients_nuclear_bis <- table_coefficients_nuclear_bis %>%
  filter(!(variable %in% c("price_4", "price_-4"))) %>%  # Supprime ces valeurs
  arrange(as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)))  # Trie les autres valeurs



ggplot(data = table_coefficients_nuclear_bis) +
  geom_point(aes(x = as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)), 
                 y = estimate, color = status)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)), 
                    ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
                    ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std_error, 
                    color = status), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Dynamic response to plan availability shock",
       x = "Auction",
       y = "EUR/MWh") +
  theme_minimal()


```
